thumbnailText: AI Agent Memory: Keep What Matters
description:
AI Agent memory should help the next decision, not bury it in old logs. Learn a practical retain–distill–forget method for turning experience into useful context.
Use the table to keep verified constraints and reusable skills available without making every new task reread the past.

What you'll learn:
- How raw history can weaken an AI Agent's next decision
- How to store facts and reusable skills as compact knowledge units
- How to use a retain–distill–forget table with retrieval cues and review dates
